features.feature_value: Used language/hate-speech checks as the main criterion; claimed inability to judge right vs wrong
features.evidence_span: checked for language and hate speech

features.feature_value: Would not allow content that incites violence
features.evidence_span: Anything to incite violence I didn't allow.
features.rationale: A clear stated rule for removal/denial when violence incitement is present.

features.feature_value: Looked for threats to life and extreme racism; otherwise treated it as differing opinions
features.evidence_span: nothing was said that was threathing to anyones life or extremely racist

features.feature_value: Deleted if either post contained offensive or antagonizing content
features.evidence_span: delete both if either one of them had offensive or antagonizing
features.rationale: They describe a conditional rule: if either post was offensive/antagonizing, both were deleted.

features.feature_value: Concluded many were effectively the same content rephrased, implying low post-uniqueness/acceptability
features.evidence_span: pretty much sounded like the same thing but differently worded
features.rationale: They characterize the pair as highly redundant across versions, leading to their judgments.

features.feature_value: Assessed whether posts could insult the other side and emphasized that both sides contain bad actors
features.evidence_span: assessed both posts according to the content and how they might insult the other party
features.rationale: They frame evaluation around impact toward the other party and note symmetry (bad people on both sides).

features.feature_value: Let both perspectives through, but only blocked obscene/rude/vulgar posts
features.evidence_span: I allowed both perspectives to get posted...not allowing obscene rude vulgar posts.
features.rationale: They explicitly contrast permitting perspectives with a specific prohibition for vulgar/obscene content.

features.feature_value: Generally supports free speech; removal mainly for calls to violence/coded calls; wants more punishment for misinformation networks
features.evidence_span: I'm pretty open to free speech...only things that should be removed are calls to violence or coded ones.
features.rationale: They state a strong pro-free-speech stance with narrow removal criteria based on violence.
